title: A Night at the Cinema
setting: A cinema in town, then a cosy living room with a fireplace.

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans)

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

sentences.en: Mia and Ben go to the cinema tonight.
sentences.zh: 米娅和本今晚去电影院。
sentences.scene_prompt: In the evening, Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) walk into a bright cinema under a dark sky.

sentences.en: First, they look at the snack menu.
sentences.zh: 他们先看了看零食菜单。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) look up at a picture menu of popcorn and drinks above the cinema counter.

sentences.en: The film tells an exciting story.
sentences.zh: 这部电影讲了一个精彩的故事。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) sit in the dark cinema with popcorn and wide, excited eyes, watching the big screen.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the children excited in the cinema; the story itself can't be shown.

sentences.en: It is about a young Italian singer.
sentences.zh: 电影讲的是一位年轻的意大利歌手。
sentences.scene_prompt: On the big cinema screen, a young woman singer stands on a stage in a sunny old Italian town square with Italian flags.

sentences.en: She loves to sing and dance on stage.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢在舞台上唱歌跳舞。
sentences.scene_prompt: On the cinema screen, the young singer sings and dances happily on a stage under bright lights.

sentences.en: The dancing in the movie is beautiful.
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) smile in their seats as many dancers move across the cinema screen.

sentences.en: At home, Ben draws the singer by the fire.
sentences.zh: 回到家，本在炉火边画那位歌手。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) sits on the floor by a warm fireplace drawing a singer in a sketchbook.

sentences.en: Mia, a young writer, writes her own story.
sentences.zh: 米娅是个小作家，在写她自己的故事。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) sits by the fireplace writing in a notebook with a pencil, next to Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts).
